search_text: published ZDI-24-856 ZDI-CAN-23158 (Pwn2Own) Phoenix Contact CHARX SEC-3100 Config Manager Improper Input Validation Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2024-06-21 CVE-2024-25995 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2024-25995 7.5 AV:A/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Phoenix Contact'] ['CHARX SEC-3100'] This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Phoenix Contact CHARX SEC-3100 devices. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the CharxSystemConfigManager service, which listens on TCP port 5001 by default. title: (Pwn2Own) Phoenix Contact CHARX SEC-3100 Config Manager Improper Input Validation Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Phoenix Contact CHARX SEC-3100 devices. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the CharxSystemConfigManager service, which listens on TCP port 5001 by default. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to update a configuration. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the service account.
